quotes.quote: I know Caviar Heights very well as I bought him as a yearling and trained him as a two-year-old. He is very tough so I wasn't convinced we were going to get past him but Colin gave Windlord a terrific ride and all credit to the horse. He showed real desire and he's previously been asked to do something [pace-making] that wasn't ideal for him so it's nice for him to win a race in his own right - Andrew Balding, trainer.

He really hit the line and it's lovely training well-bred horses for Juddmonte. A jockey riding like Oisin (Murphy) is at the moment is very helpful. He was very complimentary afterwards so I think we'll look for something better now. He's in the Royal Lodge, but we'll see about that - Anna Lisa Balding, wife of trainer.
